name: rigol-ds1102e
description: Safe USB preflight, mixed pulse/static acquisition, verification, analysis, and interpretation for one or two RIGOL DS1102E probes.

interface.shortDescription: Preflight and acquire pulse or static probe signals.
interface.longDescription: Preflights a USB-connected RIGOL DS1102E without configuration writes, qualifies mixed pulse or static signal classes on one or two probes, preserves same-trigger CH1/CH2 captures, verifies artifacts, restores scope state, and produces evidence-bounded reports.
defaultPrompt: Preflight and safely qualify pulse or static signals on both DS1102E probes.
Wait for stable CH1 contact and analyze ten captures.
Measure CH1-to-CH2 pulse delay from verified captures.
